active_tone_snr.definition: 10*log10(mean(reference_signal[n]^2 over the declared active mask)/mean((noisy[n]-reference_signal[n])^2 over the same mask)). The unchanneled mask contains the first 800 samples of each 1600-sample key slot. The channel mask shifts those spans by the symmetric FIR's exact 50-sample group delay. Noise is present over every file sample, but scale is determined only on the mask.
active_tone_snr.qualification: The generator sets exactly 10 dB before quantization; the values above independently recompute the ratio from committed 16-bit PCM. These nominal-frequency fixtures do not by themselves verify the brief's accuracy target or its combined +/-1.5% offset condition.

key_set_decision.result: retain existing 16-key Q.23 order 123A456B789C*0#D; do not add a separate 12-key conformance fixture
key_set_decision.reason: The corpus has normalized amplitude rather than calibrated dBm, and the receiver thresholds, impairment grid, and mixed pass/reject labels remain unfinished. A duplicate 12-key positive sequence would add no exact rejection contract. Any later 12-key evaluation must explicitly exclude A-D and freeze level, seed, impairments, and expected reject outcomes.
